scope: Selected white/graphite county-explorer implementation, actual exported Census facts, real GeoJSON, browser contract and responsive UI checks. This is not an accuracy percentage or a general accessibility certification.
changes: Compact header, year/county controls and independent statewide annual totals.
All 29 ranked county controls; actual geometry map; selected-county inspector retaining all four original metrics.
Five monotonic dark-blue-to-cyan quantity classes with unchanged bin assignments. Selection and focus change only the outline, never the quantity fill, opacity or filter.

Statewide annual-total strip, selected-geography trend/building mix, complete comparisons, source/quality/run receipts, freshness, exact snapshot download and original error/nullable/source-binding safeguards retained.
Bright orange controls use dark text; large orange changes and small dark accent links measured independently.
Unknown selected and statewide totals wrap without clipping or overlapping neighboring metrics.
Self-hosted original MIT Tabler icons and app-specific favicon; no font or icon CDN, new runtime dependency or paid service.

verification_rounds.stage: Initial sharp UI after inspector unknown-value correction

verification_rounds.header_cases: Both engines, both phone widths, all five years; actual quantities, unknown units, unknown buildings and both unknown. Range text stays within viewport and does not overlap neighboring header text.
verification_rounds.note: The 89 baseline scenarios were rerun. The 80 header cases are an incremental verification round, not 80 unique additions to an accuracy score; they overlap earlier responsive cases.

visual_qa.reference: User-selected combined direction: compact white/graphite layout and quantitative blue/cyan map.
accepted_differences: Official county topology and actual source-derived quantity classes take precedence over illustrative reference geography.
Four required selected-geography metrics and explicit source context remain visible.
The wordmark is real text, with licensed utility icons; no generated or handcrafted fake brand mark.

reproduce: Optional scripts/check_dashboard.cjs uses BASE_URL, PLAYWRIGHT_MODULE and ARTIFACT_DIR. Only CSS token/background selectors and a stronger header non-overlap assertion changed; numeric, source, nullable and error assertions were not weakened.
limits: Source accuracy remains separately verified against original Census files. This UI review did not re-download or modify Census data.
Contrast checks cover tested text, controls and focus surfaces; they do not establish full WCAG conformance.
This receipt records local/browser QA; the coordinator verifies actual publication and deployed runtime separately.
